senses.gloss: J. b. Gershom (<cite ref="Judges 18:30">Jud. XVIII, 30</cite>), a priest of idolatry, supposed to be a descendant of Moses.
units: <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:5:3">Cant. R. to II, 5</cite>; <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 34:5">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XXXIV</cite>; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 9:2:12">Y. Ber. IX, 13ᵈ</cite> top; a. e.

senses.gloss: J. b. Uziel, author of the Chaldaic version of the Prophets (v. Zunz, Gottesd. Vortr. p. 66, sq.).
units: <cite ref="Megillah 3a:5">Meg. 3ᵃ</cite> <he>תרגיס של נכיאים י׳ וכ׳</he> the version of the Prophets has been composed by J. b. U. at the dictation of Haggai &c.
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Nedarim 5:6:3">Y. Ned. V, end, 39ᵇ</cite> <he>גדול שבהן י׳ ב׳ ע׳</he> the greatest among the disciples of R. Joh. b. Zaccai, was J. &c.

<cite ref="Chullin 70b:12">Ḥull. 70ᵇ</cite>; a. v. fr.—[<cite ref="Eruvin 96a:11">Erub. 96ᵃ</cite> <he>י׳ הקיטוני</he>.]—[<cite ref="Pirkei Avot 4:9">Ab. IV, 9</cite>, v. Frank. Darkhé, p. 147, note.]
